decisions.reason: The drain-alignment instruction applies to this bathroom, but a complete same-message MODIFY already records the constraint.
The existing message-41 MODIFY already records both the applicable toilet drain-alignment constraint and the Unit 2 bathroom-door position.
Updating toilet positions to avoid drain conflicts does not change the Unit 3 kitchen-counter arrangement or its bathroom-door clearance strategy.
The toilet drain-alignment decision does not alter the open-plan kitchen configuration, cabinet quantities, or cabinet dimensions.
The bathroom plumbing instruction has no necessary effect on whether the Unit 3 balcony is retained or enclosed.
Repositioning bathroom toilets relative to existing drains does not change the requirement for one private steel entrance door per dwelling.
The source specifies toilet placement relative to drains but does not necessarily change any existing wall-preservation, demolition, or construction rule.
The furnished-drawing request is a separate clause already represented by its own same-message INTRODUCE; the toilet drain-alignment change adds no further modification.
The toilet drain-alignment instruction does not change Unit 1's 2+1 room program or room counts.
